title: Emolysis template profile constraints (profile_constraints.json), format v0
description: What a template needs from the platform profile it runs against; see docs/format.md.

platform.description: Must equal the platform in template.yaml.

profile_version.description: Comma-separated comparisons against the integer profile version, for example ">=1" or ">=1,<3". A bare number means ==.

requires.description: Features the platform must provide, for example "delta".

forbids.description: Features that must not be in use.
